uiSource.snapshotRule: At execution, rediscover current approved presentation paths and display helpers, review added/changed/missing inputs, update file hashes and taskReferences, then freeze the selected source in ignored local scratch. Target runtime must use baseline auth, API, permissions, validation, crypto and recovery; preview data/mocks/demo behavior are reference-only.

discovery.rules: Discover recursively including hidden/ignored presentation inputs, excluding secrets, dependencies, build output and test files. The file list is a provenance inventory, not permission to copy demo/auth/API/business logic into runtime.
discovery.onDelta: Classify added/changed/missing inputs and update hashes plus affected taskReferences before freezing. Preserve all baseline route/action obligations; route additions in preview do not replace baseline routes.

taskReferences.use: Discover and hash all approved presentation inputs; map additions before freezing. This task consumes metadata, not legacy render source.
